title: Wonders of Wildlife Stream Cleanup

description: Wonders of Wildlife Stream Cleanup takes place on Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 9:00 AM. It is held at the Springfield Art Museum Hatch Lawn, 1111 E Brookside Dr in Springfield, MO. The event is an outdoor community gathering aimed at a business audience.
